title: Activation of clopidogrel
compartment: Absorbed in the intestine; oxidised on the hepatocyte endoplasmic reticulum membrane

steps.note: Esterases hydrolyse 85% of the dose to an inactive acid

steps.enzyme: CYP2C19, with CYP3A4, CYP2C9 and CYP2B6
steps.note: 2-Oxo-clopidogrel is a thiolactone; ring opening frees the thiol

steps.enzyme: non-enzymatic binding to a free cysteine of P2RY12
steps.note: Irreversible; the platelet is affected for 7 to 10 days
